generator.program.note: The program the authors chose to grow this taxon's rosette succulent species (named in each species' spec until G2.3a moved it here).

traits.note: VicFlora's account of the family, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): flowers actinomorphic or rarely slightly zygomorphic; tepals 6, free or fused, in 2 whorls of 3; stamens 6 in 2 whorls of 3, mostly hypogynous; ovary superior, carpels as many as the perianth whorl (Watson and Dallwitz) and fused (Hortflora).

traits.leaf_division.note: Hutchinson (vol. 2, 2nd ed., 1959), family 372 Liliaceae, whose asphodels, aloes and day-lilies APG puts in Asphodelaceae: leaves simple, in a basal tuft or rosette; fruit mostly a capsule opening along its cells, rarely a berry.
